title: The First Month and the Paid Membership
lessons: The player reaches checkout and learns the ring purchase includes a first month of Oura Membership but deeper features continue through a paid membership.
The player checks Oura during a demanding workday and opens the Stress Management hub.

text: The player reaches checkout and learns the ring purchase includes a first month of Oura Membership but deeper features continue through a paid membership.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Wait. The ring price is not the whole price?

entry-first-2.speaker: OURA
text: The ring is the hardware. The deeper app features and guidance continue through membership.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: After I already bought the ring.

entry-first-4.speaker: OURA
text: The first month comes with it. After that, the membership is a separate recurring cost.

choice-first.speaker: OURA
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I expected software to be part of a smart ring.
I do not love buying hardware and then paying to fully use it.
If the useful part needs a subscription, I am out.

first-1.speaker: OURA
text: Then the recurring relationship makes sense to you.

first-2.speaker: OURA
text: Yes. The recurring cost belongs in the purchase decision.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Before I get attached to the score.

first-2-2.speaker: OURA
text: Ideally before that.

first-3.speaker: OURA
text: That is a clean reason not to buy me.
The player checks Oura during a demanding workday and opens the Stress Management hub.

entry-return-1.speaker: OURA
text: This is physiological stress, not me reading your inbox.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: Important distinction. My inbox is doing enough.

entry-return-3.speaker: OURA
text: Daytime Stress, Resilience, and Cumulative Stress sit together so you can see whether the pressure is becoming a pattern.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: And you still do not know what caused it.

entry-return-5.speaker: OURA
text: Correct. I know signals. I do not know your boss.

choice-return.speaker: OURA
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like seeing whether this week is actually wearing me down.
A chart can make me more stressed about being stressed.
I do not want my workday turned into another health dashboard.

return-1.speaker: OURA
text: Then the trend is giving language to something you already felt.

return-2.speaker: OURA
text: Yes. Tracking can become its own stressor if you keep checking it.

return-3.speaker: OURA
text: Then close the hub. Not every feeling needs a graph.
